name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic 官方 Agent 编程助手 CLI，支持沙箱内代码全自动探索与工程演进。
installSteps: if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm || true; fi

npm_config_prefix="$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR" npm install -g --ignore-scripts @anthropic-ai/claude-code --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com || npm_config_prefix="$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR" npm install -g --ignore-scripts @anthropic-ai/claude-code

printf '#!/usr/bin/env sh
MODULE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code" && pwd)"
if [ -f "$MODULE_DIR/cli-wrapper.cjs" ]; then
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/cli-wrapper.cjs" "$@"
elif [ -f "$MODULE_DIR/cli.js" ]; then
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/cli.js" "$@"
else
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/index.js" "$@"
fi
' > "$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/claude"

name: Android 统一开发套件 (acli & SDK Tools)
description: 包含 Android 统一命令行 (acli)、OpenJDK 17、ADB 调试桥、aapt 与 zipalign 等 Android 开发与设备调试工具链。
installSteps: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-17-jdk-headless adb aapt zipalign wget curl python3 ca-certificates || true

if [ ! -x /opt/gradle-8.7/bin/gradle ]; then curl -fsSL -m 60 https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/gradle/gradle-8.7-bin.zip -o /tmp/gradle-8.7.zip && python3 -c 'import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile("/tmp/gradle-8.7.zip").extractall("/opt/")' 2>/dev/null && rm -f /tmp/gradle-8.7.zip; fi
if [ -x /opt/gradle-8.7/bin/gradle ]; then ln -sf /opt/gradle-8.7/bin/gradle $TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/gradle; ln -sf /opt/gradle-8.7/bin/gradle /usr/local/bin/gradle 2>/dev/null || true; fi
for b in adb aapt zipalign java javac; do src="$(which $b 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/bin/$b)"; if [ -x "$src" ]; then ln -sf "$src" "$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/$b"; fi; done

if [ -f /opt/taixu/assets/tools/acli ]; then cp -f /opt/taixu/assets/tools/acli $TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/acli; elif [ -f /usr/local/bin/acli ]; then cp -f /usr/local/bin/acli $TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/acli; else curl -fsSL -m 10 https://mirror.ghproxy.com/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ErikHellman/cli-for-android/main/install.sh | bash 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f /usr/local/bin/acli ]; then cp -f /usr/local/bin/acli $TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/acli; fi; fi

name: Android 逆向分析套件 (APKTool & JADX)
description: 包含 APKTool（资源与Smali解包回编译）、JADX-CLI（全自动APK转Java源码反编译器）、aapt、zipalign 与 OpenJDK 17 等专业安卓静态逆向与代码审计工具链。
installSteps: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-17-jdk-headless apktool aapt zipalign wget curl python3 ca-certificates || true
for b in apktool aapt zipalign java javac; do src="$(which $b 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/bin/$b)"; if [ -x "$src" ]; then ln -sf "$src" "$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/$b"; fi; done

if [ ! -f $TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/jadx/bin/jadx ]; then rm -f /tmp/jadx.zip; for url in 'https://mirror.ghproxy.com/https://github.com/skylot/jadx/releases/download/v1.5.0/jadx-1.5.0.zip' 'https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/skylot/jadx/releases/download/v1.5.0/jadx-1.5.0.zip' 'https://github.moeyy.xyz/https://github.com/skylot/jadx/releases/download/v1.5.0/jadx-1.5.0.zip'; do if curl -fsSL -m 20 "$url" -o /tmp/jadx.zip 2>/dev/null || wget -q --timeout=15 --tries=2 -O /tmp/jadx.zip "$url" 2>/dev/null; then if [ -s /tmp/jadx.zip ]; then break; fi; fi; done; if [ -s /tmp/jadx.zip ]; then (cd $TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/jadx && (python3 -c 'import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile("/tmp/jadx.zip").extractall("'$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR'/jadx")' 2>/dev/null || jar xf /tmp/jadx.zip 2>/dev/null || true)); rm -f /tmp/jadx.zip; fi; fi

name: Flutter 跨平台开发套件
description: 包含 Flutter SDK (ARM64)、Dart、OpenJDK 17、Gradle 8.x 与国内镜像环境，支持跨平台 Flutter App 极速构建与直接安装运行。
installSteps: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-17-jdk-headless git curl wget xz-utils ca-certificates adb aapt zipalign || true

if [ ! -f $TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/sdk/bin/flutter ]; then (cd $TAIXU_TOOL_DIR && (git clone -b stable --depth 1 https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/flutter-sdk.git sdk 2>/dev/null || git clone -b stable --depth 1 https://gitee.com/mirrors/Flutter.git sdk 2>/dev/null || true)); fi
for b in java javac adb aapt zipalign; do src="$(which $b 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/bin/$b)"; if [ -x "$src" ]; then ln -sf "$src" "$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/$b"; fi; done
